days.title: Lower Basin and Northwest Pastures
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Lago Lauson
stops.detail: It can be reached by car via a narrow, mostly unpaved former military road that in about 15 km leads to the vicinity of Lake Lauson (2,017 m), where there is a mountain pasture farm selling cheese, a picnic area with tables, and a fountain.

stops.name: Bivacco Formaggino
stops.detail: In a north-westerly direction, it continues level and crosses a ridge, where the Formaggino Bivouac is located (closed), used by the Park Authority, before descending through some hairpins to reach the old, now abandoned mountain huts of Alpe Cialancia (1,845 m), near the stream of the same name

days.title: The High Lakes and the Basin Rim
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Rocca Bianca
stops.detail: It also includes the Basin (2,451 m) with the small lakes and the south-east slope of Rocca Bianca.

stops.name: Laghi Cialancia
stops.detail: In a southerly direction, it overcomes a height difference with two hairpins, before starting a wide arc in a south-westerly direction slightly uphill, which runs along the perimeter of the basin until ending at its head, where the Cialancia Lakes (2,455 m) and the ruins of the relative mountain huts are located

stops.name: Punta Cialancia
stops.detail: It is situated in mountainous territory with an altitude between 1,796 and the 2,855 m of Punta Cialancia.

stops.name: Passo della Cialancia
stops.detail: From the Cialancia Lakes, the path continues and reaches the Cialancia Pass (2,683 m), which connects the Cialancia Basin with the Plateau of the Thirteen Lakes, a hiking access point for the ridges of Punta Cialancia (to the south) and Punta Founset (to the north)
